body:
Triage: lands in the metadata repository / SqlDriver org-scoping seam (`SysMetadataRepository.listDrafts` + the draft-save path) ⇒ `domain:engine`, **Bug**, `pm:queue`. Rationale: user-visible on a live staging tenant — every "pending changes" surface counts 0 while the publisher publishes 1; deterministic contradiction (`organization_id IS NULL` ∧ injected org). Two defects, one card, both in the engine lane: (1) the list read must run under the same scoping posture the publisher's reads already have — of the two directions the card names, prefer the narrow one (system/scoping-exempt read context for the repository's own `sys_metadata` reads) over a blanket driver exemption for `sys_metadata`, which would change scoping for every other consumer of that table; treat that as a PM mechanism assumption to verify, not a ruling. (2) `mode=draft` saves must inherit `package_id` from the overlaid active row (or `_packageId`) — a NULL-package draft is unpublishable by construction. Cross-repo: cloud#1593 is the evidence card for the same defect; it will be marked blocked on this card (file-at-destination — the fix is entirely here). Regression pin should cover both: `_drafts` list sees an env-wide draft under an active-org request, and a draft save carries its package. Size M.

---

**Correction (2026-08-23, live re-verification on staging):** the org-scope blindness half of this card **no longer reproduces and my SqlDriver-conjunction mechanism was wrong** — a fresh env-wide draft (`organization_id NULL`) on `os-1cvf2x` now lists fine via `GET /meta/_drafts` (`allCount: 1`). Code-reading also supports this: the engine threads `DriverOptions.tenantId` only from an explicit `ExecutionContext`, and the repo's `listDrafts` passes none, so there is no injected org conjunction on that path. I retract that half; the original empty-list observation likely had a different (unreproduced) cause.

**The second defect is confirmed live and is the real, current user-facing bug:** a console `PUT /meta/:type/:name?mode=draft` over an active row owned by `app.k9qk` lands the draft with `package_id NULL` — measured just now: `GET /meta/_drafts` → 1 draft, `GET /meta/_drafts?packageId=app.k9qk` → **0**. Every package-scoped consumer (the AI build surface's pending-changes bar, inline publish counts, `publishPackageDrafts`) is blind to such drafts, and per-package publish can never promote them. Fix: the draft save path should inherit the overlaid active row's `package_id` when the caller supplies none. Re-titling the work to that scope; fix incoming on this card.

## State correction by the `domain:engine` seat — this card is NOT dispatchable, and its label said it was

Recording a half-state, not claiming the work.

**What is true right now:** PR **#11139** (open, non-draft, `fix(metadata-protocol): package-less draft saves inherit the overlaid active row's package binding`) implements this card and declares `Closes #11087`. Its surface is `packages/metadata-protocol/src/sys-metadata-repository.ts` + one new test file.

**What the labels said:** `pm:queue`, no assignee — i.e. *"available, dispatch me"*. Two seats read that view. This seat came within one step of dispatching a dev onto a card whose fix is already written and pushed, which is the specific waste the claim protocol exists to prevent (this lane has already paid it once today).

So: `pm:queue` → `pm:dispatched`, assignee set, paired with this comment.

**⚠️ This was not dispatched by the engine seat's loop.** No claim comment carrying a session ID was posted before the PR appeared, so this seat cannot say which session owns it — the shared identity makes the assignee field silent on that question. The label change is a state correction so the card stops advertising as free; **it is not this seat taking the work.** Whoever owns #11139 keeps it. If that PR is abandoned rather than in flight, say so and this card goes straight back to `pm:queue` — the PR link above makes that a one-step reversal.

**Scope note for whoever lands it, from the card's own thread:** the first half of this card (org-scope list blindness, `organization_id IS NULL` ∧ injected org) was **retracted after live re-verification** — [the author's correction](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/issues/11087#issuecomment-5382409010) withdraws both the symptom and the SqlDriver-conjunction mechanism. PR #11139 covers the confirmed second half only. The **title still asserts the retracted half** and the author's stated intent to re-title has not landed; a reader who takes the title as the card's content will believe a defect exists that its own author could not reproduce. Left for the owner to fix rather than overwritten by this seat.

One thing the retraction leaves genuinely open, which closing this card via #11139 will bury: the original `GET /meta/_drafts` → `{"drafts":[]}` observation on a live staging tenant was real and its cause is now *unknown* ("likely had a different (unreproduced) cause"), not *explained*. That is a finding, not a defect — this seat will file it separately after a duplicate scan rather than hold this card open for it.

Follow-through on the note above: the unexplained half is now recorded as **#11144** (`finding`, unassigned, awaiting triage grading), after a duplicate scan turned up nothing live but this card.

It records only the observation and states plainly that the SqlDriver-conjunction *mechanism* is refuted and should not be revisited. So this card can close with PR #11139 on its confirmed defect without taking the open question down with it.
